_comment: Workload replay scenarios. Each entry points at a .wlr recording captured from a real workload and the acceptance thresholds the replay must meet. Recordings are too large for the repository, so they are fetched from sampleUrl. A scenario that declares a source is mandatory: a failed download fails the case rather than skipping it. Override per scenario with the environment variable named by its 'sample' field.

idmp-lifecycle.description: IDMP sample-scenario lifecycle: schema bootstrap, sample data generation and dashboard queries
idmp-lifecycle.sampleHint: A .wlr captured from an empty instance, so it contains the CREATE DATABASE / CREATE STABLE / CREATE VTABLE statements needed to rebuild the schema on replay.

idmp-e2e.description: Full IDMP end-to-end suite workload (others + Chrome + versionControl projects) replayed on top of the lifecycle bootstrap
idmp-e2e.sampleHint: A .wlr captured while the E2E suite ran against an already-provisioned instance. It carries no schema DDL, so the bootstrap scenario has to run first.
